reference: The two friends are very serious about the toast.
sk: Dvaja kamaráti sú veľmi vážni kvôli hrianke.
cz: Dva kamarádi jsou hodně vážní kvůli toustu.
acceptable: {The two|Two} {friends|buddies} are {very|really} serious {about|because of} the toast.

mistakes.text: The two friends is very serious about the toast.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Kamaráti sú dvaja, preto patrí „are“, nie „is“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Kamarádi jsou dva, proto sem patří „are“, ne „is“.

mistakes.text: The two friends very serious about the toast.
The two friend are very serious about the toast.
The two friends are very serious for the toast.
The two friends are very serious because the toast.

source_issues: SK/CZ 'kvôli hrianke / kvůli toustu' mean 'because of the toast' (bread), not 'about'.
